purpose: Exploratory LR-only follow-up testing whether selected PIMPLE path labels help when used during target NLT fine-tuning, following the Allen-Cahn path-fine-tuning comparison.

scope.selection_metric: mean 20-step target LR autoregressive vector relative-L2

data.selected_label: first complete nonendpoint PIMPLE outer velocity state minus solver_initial velocity at each physical transition

design.factorial: 3 source initializations x 3 target objectives, all tasks; all source arms use identical target NLT and LR-validation selection
design.selected_pimple_path_target_loss: BL-RPNG safe correction-direction/log-magnitude loss on selected PIMPLE label plus endpoint relative-L2, path-gradient ratio 0.05, probe layer index 1
design.matched_endpoint_target_loss: same BL-RPNG loss and norm as selected path, with endpoint direction rescaled to selected PIMPLE label norm
design.optimizer: AdamW, lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-6, batch=4, max 100 epochs, min 30 epochs, patience 12
design.adaptation: NLT rank 4, alpha 4; source backbone frozen except the configured NLT adaptation parameters and existing trainable probe/project components
design.checkpoint_selection: best mean 20-step LR autoregressive rollout relative-L2

interpretation.target_path_signal_supported_on_lr: selected_pimple_path objective must improve over both final_only and matched_endpoint_control under the same source initialization, across F5 development and F6 LR confirmation means
interpretation.source_path_signal_supported_on_lr: selected_pimple_path source initialization must improve over final_only and matched_endpoint_control when the target objective is held fixed
interpretation.hr_claim: No HR conclusion is permitted; any follow-up confirmation requires a new sealed HR query set.
